supervisor.scope: Fresh supervisor-reported process and output checks; not an independent OS process inventory or forecast-performance assessment.

os_processes.scope: Canonical-project script paths, executable identity, PID, parent PID and creation UTC only. Raw command lines, account identifiers and credential arguments are not retained.
